$comment: Single source of container definitions: Bicep loads it with loadJsonContent and the local provisioner reads it. No throughput is declared anywhere; the account is serverless. Partition keys, indexing and TTL are justified in README.md.

containers.name: reference
containers.purpose: Fictional accounts, invoices and credit-policy versions. Read-heavy, written only by the guarded seeder.

containers.name: cases
containers.purpose: Case aggregate: cases, idempotency records, runs, usage events, proposals, decisions, timeline, credit results and outbox work.

containers.name: provider
containers.purpose: Ledger of the simulated credit provider. Separate from cases because the provider is an external system and no transaction may span it.

containers.name: leases
containers.purpose: Change feed processor leases for the Cosmos DB trigger. Never created at runtime.
